‘Open the Black Box’ asks how biases of image-datasets based on machine
learning can be made transparent. Through an artistic research dialogue, the
differences in perception between humans and machines are examined using the
example of the artificially intelligent image analysis consumer-tools.
The results of the artistic research methods show biases and prejudices of the
image analysis tool and are visualized in the form of a spatial installation. This
